// seedrehome 是 scripts/test-rehome-preload-cluster.sh 复制进生成工程的演练工具（DRILL_MODULE 换成工程的模块路径），
// 不是工程代码。它直接打开 account 的 Redis Cluster 存储（与 account 进程同一个 key_prefix），造三种角色并打印它们的
// 玩家号、Player 实体号与绑定：
//
//	home   建在 -home 服，没有换服；
//	moved  建在 -home 服，换服到 -away 并已提交（account 把他绑在别处，他在 -home 库里的档就是旧档）；
//	never  建在从不启动的 -never 服，向 -away 发起、期限 -ttl 秒的换服，谁也不来提交。
//
// -show <玩家号> 只打印那个角色当前的绑定。
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"DRILL_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	fredis "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis/driver"
	svcaccount "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/account"
)

type seeded struct {
	Kind       string                 `json:"kind"`
	PlayerID   int64                  `json:"player_id"`
	EntityID   int64                  `json:"entity_id"`
	TransferID string                 `json:"transfer_id,omitempty"`
	Binding    svcaccount.RoleBinding `json:"binding"`
}

// Player 的分类由 game 进程的装配登记；本工具不装配，按实体标记（category=entity.EntityCategoryOther）登记一次，
// 才能拼出与 game 进程相同的实体号。
func init() {
	if err := entity.RegisterEntityKindCategory(player.EntityKindPlayer, entity.EntityCategoryOther); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func main() {
	cluster := flag.String("redis-cluster", "", "Redis Cluster seed addresses, comma separated")
	prefix := flag.String("prefix", "", "account.key_prefix")
	home := flag.Int("home", 1000, "server of the home and moved roles")
	away := flag.Int("away", 1001, "target server of the transfers")
	never := flag.Int("never", 1002, "server that never starts")
	ttl := flag.Int64("ttl", 2, "TTL of the never-started transfer, seconds")
	show := flag.Int64("show", 0, "only print the binding of this player")
	flag.Parse()
	if err := run(*cluster, *prefix, int32(*home), int32(*away), int32(*never), *ttl, *show); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "seedrehome:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run(cluster, prefix string, home, away, never int32, ttl, show int64) error {
	ctx := context.Background()
	config := fredis.DefaultConfig("")
	config.ClusterAddrs = strings.Split(cluster, ",")
	client, err := driver.NewClient(config)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer client.Close()
	stores, err := svcaccount.NewRedisStores(client, prefix, 30*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	next := time.Now().UnixMilli() % 100_000_000
	service, err := svcaccount.New(svcaccount.Config{
		Accounts: stores.Accounts, Roles: stores.Roles, Servers: stores.Servers, Slots: stores.Slots, Names: stores.Names, Presence: stores.Presence,
		Verifier: svcaccount.VerifierFunc(func(_ context.Context, identity svcaccount.Identity) (svcaccount.Verified, error) {
			return svcaccount.Verified{Channel: identity.Channel, OpenID: identity.OpenID}, nil
		}),
		Allocator:     svcaccount.AllocatorFunc(func(context.Context, int32) (int64, error) { next++; return next, nil }),
		NameRules:     svcaccount.NameValidatorFunc(func(string) error { return nil }),
		SessionSecret: "seed-only", Now: time.Now, SystemNow: time.Now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if show != 0 {
		binding, err := service.RoleBinding(ctx, show)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(binding)
	}
	for _, sid := range []int32{home, away, never} {
		if _, err := service.UpsertServer(ctx, svcaccount.GameServer{ID: sid, Name: fmt.Sprint(sid), Status: svcaccount.ServerOpen}); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("upsert server %d: %w", sid, err)
		}
	}
	tag := fmt.Sprint(time.Now().Unix())
	var out []seeded
	for _, kind := range []string{"home", "moved", "never"} {
		origin := home
		if kind == "never" {
			origin = never
		}
		account, err := service.Login(ctx, svcaccount.Identity{Channel: "seed", OpenID: kind + "-" + tag, Credential: "x"})
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("login: %w", err)
		}
		role, err := service.CreateRole(ctx, account.ID, origin, kind+tag)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("create the %s role on %d: %w", kind, origin, err)
		}
		item := seeded{Kind: kind, PlayerID: role.PlayerID}
		if item.EntityID, err = entity.BuildEntityID(role.PlayerID, player.EntityKindPlayer); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if kind != "home" {
			current, err := service.RoleBinding(ctx, role.PlayerID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			item.TransferID = kind + "-" + tag
			request := svcaccount.TransferRequest{ID: item.TransferID, FromSID: origin, To: away, ExpectEpoch: current.BindEpoch,
				ExpectSeq: current.TransferSeq, Note: "drill: " + kind}
			if kind == "never" {
				request.TTLSeconds = ttl
			}
			if _, err := service.BeginRoleTransfer(ctx, role.PlayerID, request); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("begin the %s transfer: %w", kind, err)
			}
			if kind == "moved" {
				if _, err := service.CommitRoleTransfer(ctx, role.PlayerID, item.TransferID); err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("commit the %s transfer: %w", kind, err)
				}
			}
		}
		if item.Binding, err = service.RoleBinding(ctx, role.PlayerID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		out = append(out, item)
	}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	return encoder.Encode(out)
}
